title: Ulla bar Kishev
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman recounts the story at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Terumot, chapter 8. Ulla was liable to a capital penalty from the king and fled to Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi in Lod. Since the whole city was endangered, Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi handed him over to the authorities, and Elijah was angry with Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. Hyman reports that Midrash Rabbah 94:9 reads bar Kishar.

notes.text: Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:4 spells the patronym Koshav; this notice has Kishev and cites Kishar as another reading. Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi hands over the fugitive and is the person Elijah rebukes.
The consulted Terumot passage describes the authorities pursuing Ulla and threatening the town. Hyman describes him as liable to a capital penalty.
